title: Central secrets registry: D:\GitHub\.env consolidation pattern
desc: All repo credentials consolidated into one D:\GitHub\.env file outside any git repo -- structurally impossible to commit. Scripts use _load_central_env() fallback when local config missing.
steps: Location: D:\GitHub\.env -- outside all git repos so no .gitignore needed and commit is structurally impossible.
Format: KEY=VALUE lines, # comments. Sections by project: Shared (GH_PAT), Gmail OAuth2, Naver Mail, AI APIs, Slack, WKAppBot SDK, Hantoo/KIS, Kiwoom.
Scripts load with _load_central_env(): reads D:\GitHub\.env, splits on first =, returns dict. Used as fallback when local gitignored config (hh_config.json, gmail_config.json) is missing or deleted.
To add a new secret: append KEY=VALUE to D:\GitHub\.env under appropriate section comment. No other config files needed.
GitHub Actions: copy needed keys to repo Settings > Secrets > Actions. Reference as secrets.KEY_NAME in workflow env block.
Pattern for fallback in script: cfg = load_local_config() or _load_central_env_subset(['KEY1','KEY2']). Local config takes priority; central is fallback.
author: claude
